title: Honeyed Indulgent Indian Paneer Tikka Masala
description: A rich and creamy Indian dish featuring marinated paneer in a galangal-infused onion-tomato sauce, finished with a touch of honey.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, galangal paste, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the paneer to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Remove the paneer from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Add the paneer to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the paneer to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add butter and melt over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook until the mixture is soft and fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the honey and cook for an additional minute.
Return the paneer to the skillet and simmer in the sauce for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the paneer tikka masala hot, garnished with cilantro if desired.
